next.reason: The at end cases (no next record, key digits too large, optional file absent) and the AT END transfer are kept (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR21 with status '14', GR24 with status '10'; §2023:9.1.13.4 GR1, GR2). 1985 c: 'If the AT END phrase is not specified, a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure must be associated', which 1985 enforces at compile time (§1985:VIII.4.5.3 SR5). §2023:14.9.30.4 GR24 d) instead: 'If there are no applicable at end exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end of the READ statement', setting EC-I-O-AT-END if enabled. Looser: a READ with neither is now valid with defined behaviour.
